acceptance.resource_rule: Any increase above 10% requires an explicit cause and independent review; no automatic override.

interpretation.mcp: Actual SDK stdio call/envelope, empty result cache, normal cache-write cost included.
interpretation.native: Complete uncached API call, only latency_ms excluded from equality.
interpretation.quality: Old-data regression, complete output equality; no new-domain or generated-answer claim.
interpretation.resources: Startup, ingest/replay, native and actual MCP process memory measured separately.
interpretation.timing: Four ABBA rounds on one machine; all samples retained, no cold-OS or significance claim.

plan.correctness: Complete stable output must match for every query, config, engine and round. Exclude only native latency_ms. Verify source spans, exact tokenizer counts, scope, result limits, indexed content, MCP envelope and cache policy.
plan.durability: Commit plan/evaluator, then exact baseline/candidate binding before formal timing. Exclusive binding execution claim and per-worker start marker prevent duplicate runs; fsync each per-query start/finish and checkpoint every completed worker. Commit raw state and results in small checkpoints. Keep interrupted attempts and adverse metrics.
plan.failure_rule: Do not rerun completed formal measurements to select better samples, relax gates after outcomes, hide failed attempts, or claim speedup on a failed gate. A demonstrated correctness bug requires preserved failure evidence and a new explicitly documented candidate.

formal.execution: Sequential isolated workers, one host, fixed shuffled query order per round/config; no concurrent benchmark. Native cache_size=0/use_cache=False; actual MCP result cache cleared before call outside timing, cache-write cost included.

plan.resource_review: All recorded startup, ingest/replay and RSS means retained. Increase over 10% requires explicit cause assessment and independent review; no automatic waiver.
plan.scope: Exact-output efficiency versus v0.3.2 on old regression data. Existing third-party component results remain historical and do not establish a new whole-product or all-dimensions win. No generated answer or new-domain transfer claim.

binding.policy: One exclusive execution claim per binding; preserve every attempt and sample.
